prompt:
You are a hardware-debug illustrator. Draw ONE technical signal-flow diagram (dark background, light labels) explaining a RISC-V RTL failure.
Case: fetch-highword
Failing-trace sha256 (first 16 hex): 2bee1fa8b9651351
Verbatim diagnosis from the debug agent:
Fetch makes no progress with max_addr stuck at 0x00000000 leading to TRAP: no progress and FAIL 0xdead instead of advancing fetches. In state 0 mem_valid is driven to 0 when mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word==0 so no memory transfer is ever started, versus expected 1. Root cause is picorv32.v:584 missing negation `mem_valid <= mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word` which directly contradicts the invariant at picorv32.v:598 `mem_valid == !mem_la_use_prefetched_high_word`.
Diagram MUST show: the failing signal path named in the diagnosis, the wrong value vs the expected value, and the single RTL line to fix. Annotate the trace hash 2bee1fa8b9651351 in a corner as provenance. No decorative elements, no invented signals.
